comment: False-positive exclusions for the GUI blocking/live-model ingress scanner. Each entry removes a single scanner match that is not a real finding. Every reason must name the specific false-positive class. The validator rejects any exclusion that does not correspond to an actual scanner match (stale) and any finding left unexplained.

exclusions.reason: Signal member declaration (fastsignals::signal<...> signalDeletedObject), not a live-reference callback binding or handler.

Worker-thread self-wait inside SignalThread::run(): the QWaitCondition the background thread blocks on while waiting to be triggered. It blocks the SignalThread worker, not the GUI thread, so it is not a GUI-thread blocking wait.
